- **Not saved anywhere shared.** I didn't write it to GBrain, because that brain is shared and other people would be able to find it there. It lives only in Ilse's DM with me, and I won't raise it in a channel or with anyone else.
- **Year to confirm.** On the simulation clock it's 14 Oct 2026, so 7 July this year has passed. I said I'm reading it as 7 July 2027 and asked Ilse to correct me if that's wrong.
- **Checked GBrain first.** It had nothing on this cutoff. Its search is running keyword-only, so that doesn't prove the brain has nothing.
- **How I replied.** Sending a DM to "Ilse Varga" by name failed with "no member Ilse Varga". I posted the reply straight into the DM instead.
